teamsPage.title: Teams
teamsPage.subtitle: Who serves where, and in which position.

empty.title: No teams yet
empty.description: Teams group the positions you schedule — Worship Band, Production, Hospitality.

create.title: New team
create.positionsPlaceholder: Worship Leader, Acoustic Guitar, Bass, Drums
create.positionsHint: Comma separated. You can add more later.

addMember.title: Add to {{team}}
addMember.hint: Anyone on the roster can join a team, with or without a login. Archived people aren’t listed.

teamForm.name: Name
teamForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What this team does, and anything people should know before serving.

teamEditor.title: Edit {{team}}
teamEditor.noRoles: No roles on this team yet.
teamEditor.newRolePlaceholder: Add a role — Bass, Sound, Greeter…
teamEditor.removeConfirm: Delete the “{{position}}” role? People scheduled in it keep their assignment but lose the role.

leaders.title: Leaders
leaders.description: Team leaders can schedule and manage {{team}} only — not other teams, plan order or the song library.

secure.label: Secure team
secure.description: People need a current eligibility record (for example a background check) before they can be added or scheduled. Missing or expired records block them.

tagRules.label: Suggest people tagged
tagRules.hint: Comma separated. Changes future suggestions only.

viewers.label: Teams that can see this roster
viewers.hint: Only matters when rosters are limited to teams (Settings → Access).

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Overrides the service type and organization for this team's requests. Saved separately.

availabilityRequests.title: {{team}} availability
availabilityRequests.unreachable_one: {{count}} selected person has no email or login and won’t be notified.
availabilityRequests.unreachable_other: {{count}} selected people have no email or login and won’t be notified.
availabilityRequests.noRequests: No requests sent for this team yet.

serviceTypeWizard.notAllowed: Only owners, admins and schedulers can add a Service Type.
serviceTypeWizard.timesInvalid: Every service time needs a date, and must end after it starts.

nameStep.title: Add a Service Type
nameStep.intro: A Service Type is a type of service that happens at your church. They usually recur weekly and are named using the main name you communicate to your congregation.
nameStep.examplesHint: Pick one to fill in the name, then edit it freely.
nameStep.nameLabel: What is your Service Type name?

timesStep.title: Set up your service times
timesStep.intro: When can people attend <0>{{name}}</0>? Add the service time(s) for the first date you would like to plan below.
timesStep.footnote: *If your service happens at 9am and 11am, add both times here. Do not add rehearsals or other times.

teamsStep.title: Lastly, add teams you lead
teamsStep.intro: Chances are, <0>{{name}}</0> needs some teams to make it happen. Create new teams by choosing any of these common teams. You can edit them, create your own, or copy teams from another Service Type later.
teamsStep.joinTeams: Add me to any teams selected.
